## Transatlantic Theory Workshop

A workshop in game theory and economic theory, connecting researchers across the Atlantic.

The Transatlantic Theory Workshop began in 2008 as a joint programme between the Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University and institutions in the Paris area. Oxford joined in 2010, and Bocconi in 2024.

## Paris Game Theory Festival

The [Paris Game Theory Festival](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/) is a recurring event, launched in 2025, bringing together workshops on game theory, information and language. It is organised by Chantal Marlats, Olivier Gossner and Christina Pawlowitsch, with meetings at the Institut Henri Poincaré and Université Paris Panthéon-Assas.

Editions: [2025](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/2025) · [2026](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/2026) · [2027 (forthcoming)](https://sites.google.com/view/parisgtfestival/2027)
